title: Separate Even and Odd Numbers
question: Given a list of integers, create and print separate lists for even and odd numbers.
code:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = [number for number in numbers if number % 2 == 0]
odds = [number for number in numbers if number % 2 != 0]
print("Even:", evens)
print("Odd:", odds)
explanation: List comprehensions build new lists by keeping items that satisfy a condition.
